card.name: The word "if" after prohibitions
card.fires_on: The word "if" right after a negative instruction such as "Do not use/administer the product" or "should not be resumed". It is most often followed by particles or discoloration in the solution.

modes.label: The phrase "Do not use if"
modes.description: "if" after "do not use/administer" the vial, bag or solution, before a visible-particle or discoloration condition.
modes.example: Do not use the infusion bag<< if>> particulate matter is observed.

modes.label: Other prohibitions
modes.description: "if" or "to" after a negative or discontinuation phrase about treatment.
modes.example: Treatment should not be resumed<< if>> a plausible alternative etiology for the signs

card.plain: It responds to the point where a label states a prohibition and then introduces a condition, such as particles in the vial.
